$comment: Gapper profile catalog — static templates per IP-LAW-7 (RFC 0002 / IP-A8). Selecting a profile pre-fills the Gapper tab's queue form; every value stays editable per ticker. Times are US Eastern (market clock).

profiles.name: Classic Gapper
profiles.description: The bread-and-butter premarket gap-and-go: 5%+ gap on 2x volume, in at 4AM, rollover watch from 9:15, flat by 9:28.

profiles.name: Penny Runner

profiles.description: Liquid name gapping on news: 3-12% gap is meaningful at size, tighter stop, more patience into the bell.
